desc:
A roleplay experience based on the ST series.
We feature content from all eras of the show so you can roleplay however you want with your favourite characters.
All canon characters from the show are free.
Some custom characters are gamepass morphs so we can pay the developers, but they are free in private servers!
Consider trying our game!

-To use free fly, type ;fly in the chat

Do not participate in ANY form of innapropriate activity/roleplay in this game, players have a right to report you directly to me and the offender will be permanently banned from this game.
